name: pet
description: A little cardboard box on the Windows desktop, always on top, that says in a speech bubble what Claude is doing: the file it reads or changes, the command that runs, what a guard held, and a short summary at the end of a turn. Drag it anywhere, right-click for quiet time. Built once with the C# compiler that ships with Windows and signed with the Sign Guard script when one is set. /pet shows it, /pet stop sends it off.

bubble.title: Desktop Pet: bubble stays … seconds
bubble.description: How long news stays in the bubble. Questions and errors stay until the next news.

summary.title: Desktop Pet: summary at the end
summary.description: off: the first sentences of the answer (no tokens). haiku: Haiku puts a longer answer in one sentence.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the texts this mod shows and writes.
